title: When the Border Turns
author: Sebastian Ashgrove
blurb: Mirabel Vane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
